usedFor: PromptMate.io runs saved prompts, and “Use a Specific Template” applies one to the text you pass.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Use a Specific Template” in PromptMate.io
bestTemplate.why: An incoming message can run a prompt, which gives you a draft reply to check.

watchOut: “Use a Specific Template” needs a template chosen, so pick it before the step runs.
